(67)kun bzang don gyi phrin las ni/rang gzhung las/mtshams bcad bshags pa dkyil 'khor las/phyag 'tshal mchod dang bzlas pa dang*/gtor tshogs rjes kyi smon lam dag

tei:div.tei:p: kun bzang don gyi phrin las ni/ rang gzhung las/ mtshams bcad bshags pa dkyil 'khor las/ phyag 'tshal mchod dang bzlas pa dang*/ gtor tshogs rjes kyi smon lam dgu bya rtsol med pa'i phrin las bsdus/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dgu las/ dang pa mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rnam par rtog pa bgegs yin te/ bgegs rigs rang gi sems las byung*/ ye nas sems nyid dag zhe na/ bgegs zhes baya ba gzhan na med/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ye ta dzñā na a: gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ oṃ don dam dmigs med spros las 'das pa las/ rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyis dbang gis ni/ nongs pa mchis na rang gnong bzod par gsol/ oṃ badzra sa twa a: gsum pa dkyil 'khor las ni/ kun bzang rjogs chen ye nas brdal ba la/ phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings/ 'byu dang 'byung 'gyur yab yum lhun gyis rjogs/ hūm̐/ gdod nas snying po byang chub ngang*/ mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor (68)las/ dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs so/ bdag dang dbyer med brtan par bzhugs/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha/ bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐/ sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che/ chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal bas/ rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pa/ mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud/ na mo na ma ho/ lnga pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te/ kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis/ mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod/ ma hā pu ja ho: drug pa bzlas pa ni/ oṃ/ kun tu bzang mo gagasang ba'i bha ga tu/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus kun/ 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pas/ gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

bdun pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs/ snang stong rig stong gsal stong bde stong dang*/ dran stong grags stong tshor stong mchod pa'i tshogs/ me tog bdun (69)spos dri zhal rol mor bcas/ bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul/ oṃ shri bha tra a/ ma hā bha ling ta kha hī/ brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ tshogs kyi rgyan rnams bkra pa yang*/ rang bzhin gnas pas 'grib pa med/ lhun gyis gnas pas mi bsngo ste/ gdod nas dag pa'i bdud rtsi yin/ ma hā ga na tsakra pu ja ho/ nam mkha'i mtha' ltar kun tu thogs pa med/ chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i klong na bzhugs/ ma bcos thogs med dur khrod gcig tu 'khyil/ ma skyes mi 'gags klong du thig le rjogs/ a/ zhes dgagu pa smon lam gzhan du gsol lo/ (70)dus gsum rgyal ba'i khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ ye shes sgyu ma'i rol pa bhi ma la/ dbyer med rig 'jin ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ gsol ba 'debs so don brgyud dgongs pa stsol/ sog mong rin chen rdo rje nas bskul ngor ngag gi dbang pos so/ 'od gsal rin chen snying po'i dkyil 'khor du/ las 'brel rig rtsal rjogs par dbang thob pa'i/ padma las 'brel rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ 'di phyi bar bar do gsum du thugs rjes zungs/ zhes bskul ba po'i ngag mi ldog tsam du chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris pa'o/// /
